CLAUDE.md.title: Wait Which Model?
CLAUDE.md.description: A Next.js site tracking frontier AI models — a models directory, Compare charts, News, a public Info/methodology page, and the Which Model? and Cost Calculator tools — driven entirely by the JSON files in data/ (no backend) and kept current by protocol-driven, web-researched updates.

AGENTS.md.title: Wait Which Model?
AGENTS.md.description: A Next.js site tracking frontier AI models — a models directory, Compare charts, News, a public Info/methodology page, and the Which Model? and Cost Calculator tools — driven entirely by the JSON files in data/ (no backend) and kept current by protocol-driven, web-researched updates.

CUSTOM_COMMANDS.md.description: Table of the project's Claude Code slash commands (/stale-data-scanner, /fact-checker, /news-scan-24h) — what each one does and when to use it versus the phrase-triggered protocol agents.

docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-28-which-.description: Task-by-task implementation plan for the Which Model? tool — a client chat page plus an API route that streams 1-3 recommendations grounded only in the site's own data/*.json, served via Groq after Vercel AI Gateway was dropped mid-execution.

docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-04-model-.description: Task-by-task implementation plan for five new model-schema fields (speed, license, apiIds, retirementDate, predecessorId), derived frontier reigns and benchmark coverage, a leaner model drawer, and three decision tools: shareable Compare, spec diff and cost calculator.

docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-03-deep-l.description: Give every model its own crawlable, unfurl-friendly URL at /models/[id], with a parallel-route modal so the directory keeps its drawer feel; approved 2026-08-03.

docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-04-model-.description: Design for adding speed, licence, API ids, retirement dates and lineage to the model schema, deriving a history of frontier reigns, and turning the Compare page into shareable, pairwise and cost-aware decision tools; approved 2026-08-04.

docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-06-daily-.description: Design for the unattended weekday sweep (launchd) that runs the health, model, stats and news protocols and opens a PR instead of writing to main — amended 2026-08-13 after the 09:00 slot lost runs to firing before Wi-Fi reconnected.

logs/sweep-report-2026-08-17.md.description: Report from the 2026-08-17 daily sweep (health, models, news): four sourced news entries added, no model, status or reign changes; includes a scope note on backfilled non-release entries.

protocols/DATA_GAP_FINDER_PROTOCOL.md.description: Fill null fields on models released in the last 6 months from primary sources only (the lab's own announcement or model card, LMArena, official leaderboards); a cell that cannot be verified stays null rather than guessed.

protocols/FRONTIER_STATUS_PROTOCOL.md.description: How status in data/models.json is computed by scripts/frontier-status.js — a major-lab flagship recency override plus a per-tier benchmark rule — so frontier is a derived signal that never goes stale by hand.

protocols/MODEL_SPECS_PROTOCOL.md.description: Find and fill speed, license, apiIds, retirementDate and predecessorId in data/models.json from primary sources; predecessorId requires an explicit replacement claim in the lab's own announcement and is never inferred from naming.

protocols/NEWS_SCAN_PROTOCOL.md.description: Refresh the News tab with all recent frontier-lab news (releases, benchmarks, funding, policy, research): interview Maia on companies, period, categories and depth first, then web-search and append sourced entries to data/news.json.

protocols/NEW_MODEL_RELEASE_PROTOCOL.md.description: Add a newly released frontier model to data/models.json with web-verified, sourced data so it appears correctly in Directory, Compare and News; frontier status is then computed, never assigned.

protocols/STATS_FILLER_PROTOCOL.md.description: Find and fill missing benchmark scores and spec fields (pricing, context window, max output, knowledge cutoff) in data/models.json with verified, sourced values; unverifiable cells are recorded in data/stats-gaps.md so re-runs skip them.
